item.title: How updates and notices work
item.body:
This board shows notices from the Flutter Deck developer. It checks when the launcher starts, every 15 minutes while it is open, and when you press Refresh. Nothing is sent from your PC except an ordinary web request.
Flutter Deck also looks for new versions by itself (see Updates). A new version replaces the launcher program only. Features that live in the game build tools, such as new game controls, come with the new Setup or the new zip from the Releases page. After installing them, press Build my game again for each game you want the new features in.

item.title: Flutter Deck 0.4.0 Beta
item.body: The first public beta. It launches Mega Man Legends, Mega Man Legends 2 and The Misadventures of Tron Bonne, built from your own US disc images. No game files are included. It has a Library, Build my game, Play with a friend, an in-game overlay, picture presets, a key editor, memory card saves, music, a signed updater and a per-user installer.
